verdict.rationale: PayPal documents real, registrable outbound HTTPS webhooks: up to 10 URLs per app, each scoped to chosen event types, with retries for up to 3 days and a signature-verification endpoint. These sit on the same REST rails the agent toolkit and agentic-commerce flows use. However, the evidence describes general PayPal webhooks, not agentic-commerce-specific events, so coverage of agent checkout, cart, or Store Sync events is unproven. Missing for 10: documented webhook event types for agentic-commerce flows (cart, agent checkout, Store Sync orders), agent-specific subscription docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of delivery.
